method: Each program was written by the generation model from the example's own text and the earlier messages of the same example, following CONVENTIONS.md, with the interpreter (docs/js/logic.js), the legend and the help pages as the only references. The first pass of every file was frozen in first-pass/ before any validation ran; every later change carries a '#! repair:' line.
